author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Shea Langeliers (thumb) has X-rays return negative
desc: Shea Langeliers exited Friday's 12-5 loss to the Miami Marlins in the fourth inning due to a left thumb contusion.
impact: Langeliers suffered the thumb injury while receiving a pitch in the first inning and played through it until he was pinch-hit for in the fourth. Following the game, Athletics manager Mark Kotsay said initial X-rays came back negative, but he will be re-examined on Saturday. He can be considered day-to-day for now, with an update on his status expected to come Saturday afternoon.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Bryan Baker records save Friday
desc: Bryan Baker faced the minum three batters in Friday's 3-1 win over the Houston Astros to pick up his 23rd save of the season
impact: Baker needed just 12 pitches to retire the side. He got Isaac Paredes to line out to second base, Christian Walker to strike out and Cam Smith to line out to shortstop. Over his last 15 appearances, he has posted an impressive 0.60 ERA and 0.47 WHIP.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Nick Martinez gives up just one run Friday
desc: Nick Martinez allowed one run on three hits and a walk with three strikeouts across 5.1 innings in Friday's 3-1 win over the Houston Astros.
impact: Martinez cruised through five scoreless innings before running into trouble in the sixth, allowing a solo home run to Yordan Alvarez and a single to Isaac Paredes before being replaced by Kevin Kelly. He has looked sharp over his last two starts, giving up just two runs across 11 innings. Martinez is scheduled to make his next start on Wednesday against the New York Yankees.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Taylor Walls swipes bag Friday
desc: Taylor Walls went 0-for-3 with a run scored and a stolen base in Friday's 3-1 win over the Houston Astros.
impact: While Walls did not record a hit or draw a walk, he reached on a fielder's choice in the eighth inning, stole third base and came around to score on a Nick Fortes RBI double. He owns a .253/.343/.310 slash line with seven stolen bases over his last 30 games and has yet to hit a home run across 201 at-bats this season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Nick Fortes records two extra-base hits Friday
desc: Nick Fortes went 2-for-3 with a home run, a double, one run scored and two RBI in Friday's 3-1 win over the Houston Astros.
impact: Fortes hit his first home run since March 31, marking his second of the season. While he owns a .651 OPS through 66 games, his best mark since 2022, he remains off the fantasy radar.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Junior Caminero slams another homer Friday
desc: Junior Caminero went 1-for-4 with a solo homer in Friday's 3-1 win over the Houston Astros.
impact: Caminero saw his six-game home run streak come to an end on Thursday, but he wasted little time hitting another one by launching a 374-foot homer off left-hander Steven Okert in the seventh inning on Friday. He has now hit 10 home runs over his last 10 games and leads all third basemen with 25 homers this season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Liam Hicks scores three times Friday
desc: Liam Hicks went 1-for-4 with two walks and three runs scored in Friday's 12-5 victory over the Athletics.
impact: Hicks scored all three times he reached base safely on Friday and has now crossed the plate in each of his four games since returning from the injured list. He hasn't missed a beat at the plate, going 6-for-18 with two walks, six runs scored and two RBI over that span.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Esteury Ruiz steals base Friday
desc: Esteury Ruiz entered Friday's game as a pinch runner in the ninth inning, stole second base and later came around to score in the Marlins' 12-5 victory over the Athletics.
impact: Despite seeing limited playing time now that the Marlins are healthy, Ruiz remains worth monitoring in deeper fantasy leagues. He owns a .244 average and .828 OPS with four home runs and 17 stolen bases in just 86 at-bats. Ruiz will likely need a couple of outfield injuries to earn regular playing time, but his speed should keep him on the 26-man roster.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Otto Lopez swipes bag Friday
desc: Otto Lopez went 2-for-5 with a run scored and a stolen base in Friday's 12-5 victory over the Athletics.
impact: Lopez didn't drive in any of the Marlins' 12 runs Friday despite batting third, but he still turned in a strong fantasy performance with two hits and a stolen base. He has now hit safely in four straight games, recording multiple hits in three of them. Over his last 30 games, Lopez is slashing .331/.368/.524 with seven stolen bases and continues to rank among the top fantasy shortstops.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Owen Caissie hits one over fence Friday
desc: Owen Caissie went 1-for-4 with a two-run home run in Friday's 12-5 victory over the Athletics.
impact: Caissie capped the Marlins' offensive outburst with a two-run homer off Mason Barnett in the ninth inning, giving the club its 12th run of the game. He has now homered in two of his last four contests and is swinging a hot bat, slashing .357/.396/.762 with five home runs over his last 15 games. As long as he continues producing at the plate, he should remain in line for regular at-bats.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Heriberto Hernandez goes yard Friday
desc: Heriberto Hernandez went 2-for-5 with a home run, one run scored and three RBI in Friday's 12-5 victory over the Athletics.
impact: Hernandez launched a 414-foot home run off Jack Perkins in the first inning, his first homer since June 23. He has recorded a hit in three of his last four games, going 4-for-13 with one homer, two doubles, two walks, three runs scored and three RBI. Hernandez has started three of the Marlins' last five games and should begin to see most of his playing time against left-handed pitching with Liam Hicks and Griffin Conine back from the injured list.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Kyle Stowers hits two dingers Friday
desc: Kyle Stowers went 4-for-5 with two home runs, three runs scored and three RBI in Friday's 12-5 victory over the Athletics.
impact: Stowers turned in a tremendous performance, blasting a 368-foot home run off Justin Sterner in the sixth inning before adding a 388-foot shot off Mason Barnett in the eighth. He has been on a tear over his last 15 games, slashing .345/.433/.759 with five home runs and 15 RBI.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Jakob Marsee goes yard Friday
desc: Jakob Marsee went 1-for-3 with a home run, a walk, one run scored and an RBI in Friday's 12-5 victory over the Athletics.
impact: Marsee snapped a prolonged slump on Friday, recording his first hit since June 27 and his first home run since June 17. He crushed a 381-foot homer off Jack Perkins in the first inning that left the bat at 106.2 mph. Marsee struggled throughout June, slashing .189/.277/.250, but fantasy managers will hope this performance marks the beginning of a strong July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Tyler Phillips struggles in short outing Friday
desc: Tyler Phillips gave up five runs on seven hits and two walks while striking out two across 3.1 innings in Friday's 12-5 victory over the Athletics.
impact: Phillips escaped a first-inning jam by stranding two runners and followed with a perfect second, but he ran into trouble over the next two frames. He surrendered a two-run homer to Nick Kurtz in the third before allowing the first four batters to reach in the fourth, giving up three more runs before exiting. Through seven starts this season, Phillips owns a 5.24 ERA and 1.37 WHIP. While he has flashed upside at times, his inconsistency makes him a difficult fantasy option to trust. His next scheduled start is on Thursday against the Seattle Mariners.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bryan Reynolds goes deep Friday
desc: Bryan Reynolds went 2-for-5 with a home run in the Pirates 9-5 loss on Friday against the Nationals.
impact: Reynolds went yard off Foster Griffin in the third inning for his 12th homer of the season.
